_about: Dynamic decals (docs/DYNAMIC-DECALS.md), part 2 of 2 of the removal proof: run with Send-Suite -Fresh after grime-save.json. Loads the city saved with a weathered community sports park in a game that has never drawn its grime: the strokes come back from the group record and are drawn again; the record counts obsolete (missing) prefabs and objects on a missing prefab (both must be 0: nothing in the save names a decal). The save is deleted at the end. Send with: powershell -File tools/suite/Send-Suite.ps1 -File suite/scenarios/grime-load.json -Fresh -Who dyn-decals
